name: persist-graphson
description: Persist GraphSON v3 ingest content for one sale-availability run. persist_graph has exactly one row, delivered inline as {"address_status": "NORMALIZED" | "UNPARSEABLE", "graph": ...}. graph is the canonical JSON text of the bare tinker:graph @value {edges, vertices}; System wraps it as {"@type":"tinker:graph","@value":<graph>} for Persist /persist/validate and /persist/ingest. Transform inline delivery carries only typed columns, so the object travels as canonical-json text. Element contents are validated by Persist against its effective lexicon, not by this language.

datasets.description: One row per run. NORMALIZED carries the graph; UNPARSEABLE carries a null graph, so no assessment is ever persisted without its address edge.

graph.description: Canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the bare tinker:graph @value {"edges":[g:Edge...],"vertices":[g:Vertex...]}. Nulls and empty arrays are omitted; arrays are g:List; *_amount_minor are g:Int64; date-times are ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds and Z. Client ids are UUIDv5 placeholders that Persist replaces with content hashes.

x-invariants.name: graph_matches_reference_builder
x-invariants.description: graph equals the canonical JSON of build_graphson.py for the same run and request address, with observations in observation_identifier order; the address vertex follows contract section 6 (rule 4a for text) and is case-insensitive.

x-invariants.name: no_assessment_without_address
x-invariants.description: UNPARSEABLE addresses yield a null graph; NORMALIZED graphs carry the address vertex and every non-null *_has_address edge.
